audio_description:
Through wrought-iron railings, a dark figure moves across the red-carpeted gate.
The camera settles on a close-up of Sorceress Edea, composed and still.

context.scene_title: The gate confrontation — a figure (Squall) advancing across the parade gate toward Sorceress Edea during the assassination attempt (Disc 1).
locations: Deling City — the ornate iron-railed parade gate dais with its red carpet, leading up to Edea

characters.name: Squall Leonhart (implied)
characters.recognition: A dark-clad figure rushes/moves across the ornate gate in motion-blurred mid-shots; consistent with Squall charging the Sorceress, though his face is not clearly shown here.

characters.name: Sorceress Edea
characters.recognition: Golden-skinned face, ram-horn headpiece, golden radial-web headdress and black feather collar, shown in close-up as the confrontation reaches her.

context.summary: Through the wrought-iron railings and over the red-carpeted gate, a dark figure moves swiftly across the parade dais. The camera settles on a close-up of Sorceress Edea, composed and imperious, as the confrontation at the gate comes to a head.
context.context_note: High confidence on Edea and the gate-confrontation setting; the advancing figure is inferred to be Squall.
